#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

struct step {
    ll val;
    int cost;
    bool operator<(const step &other) const {
        return cost > other.cost; // Min-heap behavior
    }
};

unordered_set<ll> visited;

bool wasVisited(ll c) {
    return visited.count(c) > 0;
}

step uupper(ll n) {
    ll res = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (res < n) {
        res = res * 10 + 1;
        ++i;
    }
    return {res, i};
}

step upper(ll n) {
    ll res = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (res * 10 + 1 <= n) {
        res = res * 10 + 1;
        ++i;
    }
    ll resmul = res;
    int imul = i;
    while (res < n) {
        res += resmul;
        i += imul;
    }
    return {res, i};
}

step lower(ll n) {
    ll res = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (res * 10 + 1 <= n) {
        res = res * 10 + 1;
        ++i;
    }
    ll resmul = res;
    int imul = i;
    while (res + resmul <= n) {
        res += resmul;
        i += imul;
    }
    return {res, i};
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    ll n;
    cin >> n;

    priority_queue<step> pq;
    pq.push({n, 0});

    while (!pq.empty() && pq.top().val != 0) {
        auto [val, cost] = pq.top();
        pq.pop();

        if (wasVisited(val)) continue;
        visited.insert(val);

        vector<step> candidates = {lower(val), upper(val), uupper(val)};
        for (auto &next : candidates) {
            next.cost += cost;
            next.val = abs(val - next.val);
            pq.push(next);
        }
    }

    cout << pq.top().cost << '\n';
    return 0;
}
